cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Builds a redacted presentation from an existing SD-JWT (as returned by sdjwt_issue), keeping only the listed disclosures. Pass aud to add a KB-JWT holder-binding (a fresh ephemeral holder key is generated per call). Pass issuer_did (the sd_jwt's "issuer" field) to also verify the JWS and return the verifier_view -- exactly the claim set a relying party would resolve -- plus an OCG receipt of the presentation activity.

aud.description: KB-JWT audience. Supplying this adds a holder-binding KB-JWT to the presentation.

issuer_did.description: The sd_jwt's issuer did:key, to verify the JWS and populate verifier_view + receipt.

keep_keys.description: Disclosure keys to keep in the presentation. Default: none (all disclosures redacted).

nonce.description: KB-JWT nonce. Auto-generated if aud is set and this is omitted.

sd_jwt.description: An SD-JWT string with all disclosures attached, as returned by sdjwt_issue.

name: sdjwt_present
title: Present a redacted Selective Disclosure JWT
